title: Check the approved change
responsibility: Checks that a Change request still names the approved design, contract, images and thread.

inputs.name: approvalMatch.entity
inputs.description: The catalog entity with its latest design, approval, contract, and thread records. It is consulted for Change requests; the latest version's current approval and a thread belonging to the entity must bind to the request.

examples.title: Check the approved change
examples.summary: Checks that a Change request still names the approved design, contract, images and thread.

inputs.name: approvalMatch.request
inputs.description: The run mode, entity and thread identifiers, and approval binding. Plan requests return without validation; Change requests must match the latest current approval, contract hash, image hash set, and design option.

examples.text: Prepare a plan for this unit.

outputs.name: approvalMatch
outputs.description: No return value. Normal completion means the request was not a Change or the applicable approval and thread checks passed; it does not execute or verify a change.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A synchronous Error is thrown for a Change request without a current approval or target, a mismatch in version, contract hash, image hashes, or option, a thread outside the entity, or a thread anchored to a different version or option. Image hash order is ignored, and a thread with no version or option anchor is not rejected for that missing anchor value.
